_source.how_to_read: Every `_source` key is provenance and no data: a consumer drops it. It names where the figures beside it were read, as a foreign record with its section or as a path at the commit. In the notes, the analysis is foreign:ax-k2-3:261031-1733-pipeline-work-dissected-into-parallel-checkout-lanes.md and the lane record is foreign:ax-k2-3:261101-1006-three-checkouts-work-the-pipeline-lanes-in-parallel.md.
_source.derivation: Hand-derived on 2026-11-09 from the clone named in `source`. Every source was read through git -C <clone> show 56c19983a:<path>, none from the clone's working tree, and nothing was written there.
_source.packages: Three groups, told apart by `group`. `pipeline-analysis`: the packages of the dependency table in §3 of foreign:ax-k2-3:261031-1733-pipeline-work-dissected-into-parallel-checkout-lanes.md, in the table's row order; its rows for the plan-edge family and the route build-out, which had no package at the analysis, are the containers 261101-1001 and 261101-1002 filed on 2026-11-01. `lane-amendment`: the package the lane record's amendment of 2026-11-01 put at lane 2's tail, which §3 does not name. `held-outside-lanes`: the packages whose package.json at the commit reads claimed and which neither foreign record names. The fifth claimed package at the commit, 260916-1447-be-ein-qualitaetsmass-fuer-die-befuellung, is a §3 package and a member of lane 3, so it stands in the first group.
_source.state: `status`, `holder` (the claim's checkout while the status is claimed), `claim_kept` (the checkout a done or dropped package's claim object still names), `outcome_class` and both edge lists are read from each container's package.json at the commit. Where a foreign record's prose reads otherwise, the package.json governs and the entry's `_source.disagreement` says what the prose read.
_source.depends_on: Targets by container name, resolved from each entry's `target.record_id` through the `id` of every package.json under fusion-workbench/work-packages at the commit. `depends_on` holds the edges whose target is a package of this file, so the list is closed over the file; `depends_on_outside_fixture` holds the other edges the package.json carries, each with its target's status at the commit. `depends_on_condition` is the condition of every entry in both lists. An entry's `_source.edges_named_by` says where a foreign record speaks of the package's edges; the edges themselves are the package.json's.
_source.areas: Path prefixes relative to the project root, no trailing slash, taken from the contention map in §4 of foreign:ax-k2-3:261031-1733-pipeline-work-dissected-into-parallel-checkout-lanes.md. §4 writes Go paths relative to codebase/go; they are recorded from the project root. A package named in a §4 row is given every path of that row, except where §4 annotates the package with files of its own. `areas` holds the rows whose Lane column keeps them inside the package's own lane; `shared_areas` holds the rows that column marks cross-lane, which the analysis leaves to its sync rules (§6) and not to the cut. Every recorded path exists at the commit (git cat-file -t 56c19983a:<path>). `area_rows` below is §4 row by row.

_source.lanes: The three lanes of foreign:ax-k2-3:261101-1006-three-checkouts-work-the-pipeline-lanes-in-parallel.md, `## Lanes`, read through the note `Amended: 261101-1150` at its foot. The record numbers its lanes 1 to 3; the ids lane-1 to lane-3 are this file's spelling. Members stand in the record's queue order, whatever their status at the commit. The record's fourth heading, for another person's checkout, orders no package and is no lane here.
_source.checkouts: One entry per file under fusion-workbench/shared/checkouts at the commit (git ls-tree --name-only 56c19983a fusion-workbench/shared/checkouts/). Of each entry the checkout and its alias are taken. Its `**Person:**` and `**Git identity:**` lines (a name and an e-mail address) and its `**Registered:**` and `**Refreshed:**` stamps are left out. No entry at the commit carries a hostname, an account name or a folder path.
_source.log: One `commit` row per checkout that holds a package at the commit, in the shape the commit lock writes (ts, event, person, checkout, session_id, detail), without `person`. `detail` is the row's own `<short hash> <subject>`; the hash names a commit of the foreign repository, and a test maps it onto a commit it makes. `ts` is UTC written without a zone, as the log holds it; each row's `_source.committer_time` is the named commit's own time. Session ids are synthetic.
